title: Port-Hamiltonian modelling of coupled rigid/flexible multibody systems
summary: We develop a port-Hamiltonian framework for coupled rigid/flexible multibody systems. The rigid dynamics may be nonlinear and subject to configuration and velocity constraints, while the flexible components are described by linear port-Hamiltonian partial differential equations on one-dimensional spatial domains. The subsystems interact through boundary or distributed ports. On the flexible side, the differential operator and its domain remain fixed, whereas state dependence enters only through finite-dimensional coupling components of the Dirac structure.
